summary: Four demonstrated failures: a missing source family, answer leakage, rejected equivalent blank responses, and broken blank rendering. Package files remained unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Solve elementary separable ODEs by rearranging, separating variables, integrating, and solving explicitly for y.
reasoning_steps: Rearrange and separate variables under valid domain assumptions.
Integrate both sides with an arbitrary constant.
Solve for y and select valid branches.
Choose the complete solution or enter the missing expression.
invariants: Preserve elementary separation and integration workload.
Preserve source response forms and complete answer banks.
Respect nonzero and branch restrictions without revealing the computed solution.
permitted_variations: Change small coefficients and signs while updating every dependent expression.
Vary missing polynomial expressions and supported solution scaffolds.
Shuffle choices without preserving incidental answer cues.

source_replay.details: Fourteen complete source banks replay successfully; the fifteenth family, q-128198, is rejected.

math.details: All 93 tested option banks pass independent differentiation checks. Eighty-one keyed solutions also simplify exactly to zero residual on valid local branches.

variety.details: Easy coefficients and signs vary, but the supported source family y=±sqrt(blank+K) is entirely missing.

scope.details: Normal blank prompts add a nonconstant-only restriction that narrows the source response contract to conceal an engine limitation.

grading.details: Native grading passes 17 ordinary valid and 66 wrong submissions. It rejects x^2+5 in the original arbitrary-K scaffold despite solution-family equivalence.

rendering.details: Blank scaffold fragments render as literal Markdown code blocks. Automated MathJax checks missed the visible failure.

packaging.details: Exact dependency versions match; relocation and deterministic replay pass. Declared files exist, and package hashes are unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Interval-copy shortcuts succeed on all 12 targeted cases and their delivered survivors. The exact easy batch survives 5/5 without that cue. All six captured generated inventory records reproduce; none belongs to the demonstrated defective families. Exact future learner frequencies remain unavailable.
